name: Pipe Organ MIDI Concepts
summary: Early design notes for a multi-manual MIDI pipe-organ controller using key matrices, register controls and expression pedals.
description: This repository is explicitly a collection of ideas rather than a finished build. It explores three keyboard manuals, register selection and expression control using MIDI channels, CC and Program Change.

notes: The README presents Arduino-style code examples but does not define a final controller board.

mechanics.summary: Concept focuses on keyboard matrices, register switches and an expression pedal rather than pipe-valve mechanics.
notes: Three manuals are envisaged, each mapped to its own MIDI channel.

warnings: Concept only: repository explicitly states that it is currently a collection of ideas.
